items.source: If the method parameter is Map<String, String>, MultiValueMap<String, String>, or HttpHeaders then the map is populated with all header names and values.
items.translation: 如果方法参数是Map<String, String>、MultiValueMap<String, String>或HttpHeaders，则会将所有标头名称和值填充到该映射中。

items.source: Defaults to true, leading to an exception being thrown if the header is missing in the request. Switch this to false if you prefer a null value if the header is not present in the request.
items.translation: 默认为 `true`，如果请求中缺少该头部，将抛出异常。如果您希望在请求中不存在该头部时返回 `null` 值，请将其切换为 `false`。

items.source: Supported for annotated handler methods in Spring MVC and Spring WebFlux.
items.translation: 支持 Spring MVC 和 Spring WebFlux 中的注解处理程序方法。

items.source: The name of the request header to bind to.
Alternatively, provide a defaultValue(), which implicitly sets this flag to false.
items.translation: 或者，提供一个defaultValue()，它隐式地将此标志设置为false。

items.source: Supplying a default value implicitly sets required() to false.
items.translation: 隐式提供默认值会将required()设置为false。

items.source: The default value to use as a fallback.
